==================================
Tagged template with invalid hex escape
==================================

String.raw`[0]\x`;
String.raw`\x4`;
String.raw`\xZ`;

---

(program
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (string_fragment)
        (escape_sequence))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence)
        (string_fragment)))))

==================================
Tagged template with invalid unicode escapes
==================================

String.raw`.\undefined`;
String.raw`\u`;
String.raw`\u{`;
String.raw`\u{12`;
String.raw`\u12`;

---

(program
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (string_fragment)
        (escape_sequence)
        (string_fragment))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence)
        (string_fragment))))
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      function: (member_expression
        object: (identifier)
        property: (property_identifier))
      arguments: (template_string
        (escape_sequence)
        (string_fragment)))))

==================================
Template with valid escapes keeps escape_sequence nodes
==================================

`a\x41\u0041\u{1F600}\101\n${x}\``;

---

(program
  (expression_statement
    (template_string
      (string_fragment)
      (escape_sequence)
      (escape_sequence)
      (escape_sequence)
      (escape_sequence)
      (escape_sequence)
      (template_substitution
        (identifier))
      (escape_sequence))))

==================================
String keeps strict escape sequences
:error
==================================

'\x';

---

==================================
JSX attribute and member names may be reserved words
==================================

const a = <div class="x" for="y" default="z" />;
const b = <Foo.default.return />;
const c = <class />;

---

(program
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (identifier)
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string (string_fragment)))
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string (string_fragment)))
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string (string_fragment))))))
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (member_expression
          object: (member_expression
            object: (identifier)
            property: (property_identifier))
          property: (property_identifier)))))
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (identifier)))))
